Privacy Policy

Last Updated: July 2026

1. Overview

GRICH ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you contact us or use our services. This includes:

  • Contact information (such as email address).
  • Usage data (IP address, browser type, pages visited).
  • Publicly available legal data gathered from official court dockets.

3. Use of Data

Your information is used to:

  • Provide and maintain our data analytics services.
  • Notify you about changes to our platform.
  • Provide customer support.
  • Analyze usage patterns to improve our platform.

4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies, including Google Analytics, to measure page visits and broad service interactions such as starting an intake form, submitting an intake request, and starting checkout. We do not send notice details, email addresses, store names, case numbers, or uploaded-file links to Google Analytics. You can instruct your browser to refuse cookies; some site features may then work differently.

5. Data Disclosure

We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We may disclose your data if required by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: support@jaxfamlaw.com
